provenance.note: SYSTEM 7.3 mapping: LOINC first in Observation.code, valueQuantity with http://unitsofmeasure.org codes; LOINC 8867-4 heart rate, 9279-1 respiratory rate, 2708-6 with 59408-5 oxygen saturation by pulse oximetry, 8310-5 body temperature, 8480-6 and 8462-4 under the 85354-9 blood pressure panel (health-data-standards.md 6).
Indicator codes and UCUM units: pulse /min, spo2 %, temperature Cel, systolic_bp and diastolic_bp mm[Hg] (D12).

NASA CHP-IDSP Project Updates (NTRS 20250000330): heart rate, blood pressure, temperature and blood oxygen levels are collected data packaged as the crew member's patient file; an imported report is that data with its report provenance, never a connected device.

LOINC 8601-7 EKG impression. Non-NASA source: no NASA catalog document defines clinical terminology codes. Kept as a qualitative finding with its source codings and text, never a number and never confirmed by import.
